race.comment: KIWI GEORGE (7) turned in a plain run last time when fifth at this track over 450m behind Hara's Oden (25.80) in a Grade 4/5. Was in the money the start prior. Better than last start and worth following up. SPRING MILES (3) has a strong record here with two wins and a minor from four starts. Hit the frame latest (30.40) when third at The Meadows in a Grade 5. Makes strong appeal on best. PAW JASTA (4) slotted in just off the lead from the wide draw last start and boxed on to finish second (25.44) at Warrnambool in a Grade 5 H over 450m. Must be included in calculations. HARTLAND ROCKET (1) is worth consideration after filling a hole at this course and distance last start.
